heroHeadline: Russia Kills 9 in Two Nights of Kyiv Strikes as Ukraine Hits Russian Refinery 1,450km Inside Russia
heroSubtitle: Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles and drones overnight into September 24, killing 2 and injuring 8 and damaging Maternity Hospital No. 2 and the historic 1906 St. Pokrovsky Church, then hit the capital again overnight into September 25 with a mass drone barrage across six districts plus Brovary and Lutsk, killing 7 — including two children — and injuring 59. Ukraine responded on September 25 with long-range drone strikes on the Lukoil oil refinery in Perm (~1,450km inside Russia, 1 killed), the Iskra defense-electronics plant in Ulyanovsk (8 injured) and the Voronezhsintezkauchuk synthetic-rubber and rocket-propellant plant in Voronezh (13 injured); Russia claimed 592 drones intercepted overnight. Separately, Russian drones struck a medical center and ambulances in Zaporizhzhia on September 25, injuring 1. Russian cumulative personnel losses reached approximately 1,525,570 by September 25, per the Ukrainian General Staff.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, CNN, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, Ukrainska Pravda, Kyiv Post, Euronews, PBS NewsHour, GlobalSecurity.org, United24 Media, Wikipedia War Timeline, and the Ukrainian General Staff. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
